findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/dev-memory-supersession-smoke.ts:94 reads the real global dev-memory path and lines 138-145 require machine-specific global rows a4d08a8/9890b83. Because packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes.ts auto-discovers *-smoke tasks and package.json exposes test:all/test:coverage through that runner, the committed smoke is no longer hermetic. Repro: env LATTICE_GLOBAL_MEMORY_DIR=$(mktemp -d) node packages/main/dist/tasks/dev-memory-supersession-smoke.js fails with AssertionError: <tmp>/experience.jsonl should exist. This blocks quality because routine smoke validation can fail on a clean machine or different global memory state even though the product code is fine.
